description: Prepare a market call. Always returns a link where a person reviews and locks it in their own wallet (Aevum never signs for anyone). If `address` is given, also returns the exact call text and unsigned Ethereum transactions, for an agent that signs with its own wallet and then calls publish_call. Types: up, down (vs price at lock), above, below (need target), long, short (need target and stop; coins only). sym: BTC, any Coinbase USD coin (ETH, SOL...), or a Kraken tokenized stock like NVDAx. days: 7, 14, 30, 60, 90.

address.description: Optional: the wallet that will sign the lock (for agents with their own wallet)

reason.description: One-line reason, max 280 characters (part of the locked text)

sym.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, NVDAx

name: draft_call
title: Draft a call to lock
